title: Compose bootstrap environment
description: Allowed keys for examples/compose/.env. SQL host/user/password live in OpenBao, not here.

MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD.description: Optional; only when starting the compose mysql service (database.type=mysql). Connection used by MCP lives in OpenBao secret/reksicherung/mysql.

REKSICHERUNG_IMAGE_TAG.description: Tag for ghcr.io/1k-off/reksicherung/* images (default latest). Operators pull; build is developers-only.

REKSICHERUNG_OPENBAO_PLAINTEXT.description: Lab-only: allow http:// OpenBao to non-loopback hosts (compose service DNS)
